title: Gazpacho
description: Chilled Spanish tomato soup blended with cucumber, pepper, garlic, sherry vinegar and olive oil. No cooking, just ripe summer tomatoes.

image.alt: A bowl of chilled tomato gazpacho topped with diced cucumber and pepper

steps.text: Put the tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, onion, garlic, bread (if using), vinegar and salt in the blender.
Blend until completely smooth, about {time 1 min notimer}. With the blender running, pour in the oil in a thin stream; the soup will turn a lighter orange-red and creamy.
Taste and adjust the salt and vinegar. For a silkier soup, press it through a sieve.
Chill for at least {time 2 hr notimer}; gazpacho needs to be really cold. Serve in bowls or glasses with a drizzle of olive oil and finely diced cucumber on top.

notes: It is only as good as the tomatoes, so make it in summer when they are ripe and sweet.
Leave out the bread for a gluten-free soup. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
